messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up team — Meridian QBR next Wed 10am PT. Need a concise deck: onboarding snapshot, health signals, renewal risk, and a 5-min demo cadence. Who picks what?
Ajay Patel: I9ll own onboarding. Will pull integration success rate + outstanding flows. Target: end of day Tues.
Taylor Brooks: I9ll take the health metrics slide (cost, latency, adoption). Execs prefer a single slide with 3 bullets. Any preferred visuals?
Sofia Ruiz: Single-slide summary + 1 detail appendix usually works. I can craft the signal summary and call out top renewal flags (drop in DAU, unresolved P1s).
Devon Li: I9ll sketch the demo script and an alternate flow if the new webhook still fails. Keep demo to 5 mins.
Maya Chen: Great. Also include a short customer feedback snapshot (last 30 days) for the execs 3 like an NPS-blend and top qualitative comment.
Ajay Patel: Will add feedback. Quick SQL I9m running to pull issues:
SELECT count(*) AS cnt, severity FROM onboarding_issues
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY severity ORDER BY cnt DESC;
Taylor Brooks: Can someone drop the latest billing extract into the doc? I9ll plot cost per active and 3-month trend.
Sofia Ruiz: Pushed a link in the doc: https://redwood-internal.docs/qbr/meridian. Also attached 3 support threads for context.
sync-bot: Reminder created: "Meridian QBR slide freeze" Tue 6:00pm PT.
Maya Chen: Owners recap: Ajay = onboarding + feedback row; Taylor = exec metrics + cost trend; Sofia = renewal-signal slide + support context; Devon = demo cadence + fallback. I9ll be slide owner and run the rehearsal.
Devon Li: Suggest a canary package if renewal risk hits medium: 2-month onboarding assistance + 15% usage credit. I9ll draft impact numbers.
Sofia Ruiz: Add a KMS/privacy note 3 Meridian asked about enterprise KMS in their last call.
Ajay Patel: Noted. I9ll confirm any open privacy tickets and surface them in the appendix.
Taylor Brooks: Proposal: one-line TL;DR on slide 1, 3 bullets (usage trend, cost delta, risk), and an appendix with mitigation options. Keep it <6 slides.
Maya Chen: Perfect. Can we schedule a 15-min dry run Tue 12pm PT to align?
Sofia Ruiz: I9ll book it and invite demo folks.
sync-bot: Event scheduled: "Meridian QBR dry run" Tue 12:00312:15 PT 3 attendees: Maya, Ajay, Taylor, Sofia, Devon.
